about: Sourced material-property pool for EUROAVIA Ideathon 2026 (Ansys: topology optimisation + materials selection + eco audit). Built 2026-11-03. Tags: D = read from the primary source (datasheet, handbook, standard, original paper) - either in this session (2026-11-03: MIL-HDBK-5J local PDF, EOS IN625, Victrex 450G, Stratasys ULTEM 9085 and Nylon 12CF, EOS PA 2200, Eckart A205, Aubert & Duval Ti5553, ICE v2.0) or in the 2026-11-01/02 sessions recorded in the project notes named in each source string (those tags are inherited, not re-read); S = secondary (distributor, compilation, review, search snippet); Y = own calculation, proxy or judgement. Units: rho kg/m3, E GPa, Fty/Ftu/fatigue MPa, k W/mK, cte 1e-6/K, Tmax C, co2 kg CO2e/kg, price currency in unit. Metal strengths are design allowables (A- or S-basis) where MIL-HDBK-5J has them, AM and polymer values are typical. Optional keys: condition, low, high. Missing keys = NOT FOUND (see README.md). Conversions: 1 ksi = 6.894757 MPa, 1 lb/in3 = 27679.9 kg/m3, 1 Btu/(h ft F) = 1.7307 W/mK, 1e-6/F = 1.8e-6/K.
